result.topic_en: A dated schedule of sessions of a physics (mathematical-physical) seminar, listing lectures, exercises and laboratory determinations such as testing a Mendelssohn balance, a cocoon-thread balance, the elastic modulus of brass from the tone of a sounding rod, the constants of a bifilar magnetometer, and topics raised by the solar eclipse.
